About us

We believe everyone deserves opportunities

Jomart Jurek is a community united by support, respect and the desire to make life kinder.

We create opportunities to connect, learn, be creative and enjoy sports. Through our events, we help people with disabilities stay active, discover their abilities and make new friends.

We want everyone to feel that they are not alone: they are heard, valued and supported.

Our mission is to support adults and children with disabilities, prevent social isolation, and create opportunities for communication, development, education and active participation in society.

Projects and events

Doing good together

We organise activities for persons with disabilities and children, help people facing difficult circumstances and create opportunities for friendship, creativity, sport and active participation.

🎉

Celebrations and gatherings

We organise celebrations, meetings and outings where everyone can feel part of a warm, welcoming community.

🎁

Targeted support

We provide gifts, school supplies, food, hygiene essentials and practical help to people with disabilities and families in need.

🏆

Active living

We create opportunities for sports, creativity, meeting people and making friends, so everyone can discover their abilities.

🍎

Regular assistance

When funding allows, we prepare food parcels and provide practical everyday support to the people we serve.

🎒

Back to school

We help children prepare for the school year by providing school supplies and other essentials.

🌿

Outings and connection

We organise shared leisure activities and outings that help people connect, make friends and avoid isolation.

Our big dream

Generous Heart House

We dream of creating a warm, accessible and lively centre for persons with disabilities in Karaganda — a place to meet, learn, exercise, make friends and develop abilities.

Today, many people with disabilities lack accessible places to connect and grow. Some spend most of their time at home; others struggle to find activities, work or friends. Generous Heart House is our dream of changing this.

🤝 A place to meet and connect

A welcoming hall for events, celebrations, gatherings, workshops and evenings together, free from loneliness and isolation.

📚 Learning and development

Dedicated classrooms for computer skills, languages, creative activities and educational programmes.

💼 Opportunities to work

Jobs and small workshops where people can use their abilities, gain experience and feel valued.

🏆 Sports without barriers

A gym, exercise equipment and a dedicated space for adaptive sports, including Showdown.

🌿 Outdoor space

Landscaped grounds with greenery, a gazebo, seating, outdoor fitness equipment and a swimming pool.

🎨 Creativity and a greenhouse

Creative workshops, clubs and a small greenhouse for practical skills and meaningful activity.

We want to create a home people come to for opportunities, not pity. A home where everyone can say: “I am welcome here. I am valued here. I am not alone.”

Why I founded Jomart Jurek

My name is Igor Proskurin. I am the founder and chairman of Jomart Jurek. As a person with a disability, I know what it means to truly need help.

There was a time when I was almost bedridden and unable to work, and my family was struggling. My mother and my wife stayed by my side. Their support helped me keep going. That experience showed me how much it matters to know you are not alone during difficult times.

That is how Jomart Jurek — “Generous Heart” — began. Today, we bring people together, organise events, offer help and create new opportunities for people with disabilities.

I cannot change the whole world. But I believe that together we can change the world for at least one person. Sometimes, that is where something wonderful begins.

Igor Proskurin
Founder and Chairman of Jomart Jurek
